_contract: What the Phase-C2 REPLAY requires the pod's frozen assets to BE, checked by scripts/autoinit/verify_frozen_assets.py --expect before anything is materialized. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
_why_this_exists: The replay declares ASSETS_READY, and a session that declares it must name its own expectation -- explicit or refused, never inherited. Search-1's document names exactly one asset, state_eval_v1, the metric suite every candidate is ranked on. This session RANKS NOTHING and does not stage that suite, so pointing at Search-1's document would demand an artifact this session neither stages nor needs. That is the $0.0552 Phase-C2 abort with the names changed. Attempt 7 cost $0.05 establishing the same thing from the other direction: declaring the marker and naming no document at all.
_what_the_replay_consumes: exactly the two calibration mixtures its five pinned paths name: calib.domain_balanced@v1 at 17 of the 20 steps and calib.reasoning_heavy@v2 at 2. The twentieth step is depth.positional_v0, which carries the calib.none@v1 sentinel and reads no items at all. The mixtures matter because an operator resolves its profile from disk: a drifted mixture would change every statistic without changing any recorded identity, and every artifact digest downstream of it would diverge.
_scoring_contract_is_absent: deliberately, not omitted by accident. The verifier checks a contract only when an expectation asks for one, and the replay consumes no scoring contract: it trains nothing and scores nothing.
_identities_are_derived_not_transcribed: computed by this project's own hashing -- content_sha256 read from each manifest, manifest_sha256 canonicalized by verify_frozen_assets.canonical_manifest_sha256, items_sha256 over the raw bytes of items.jsonl.
